name: Somchai Wongsanit
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting. While he lacked the funds to pursue a racing career himself, his passion never waned. After excelling in logistics management courses at university, he sought to combine his academic skills with his love for racing. He started as an intern, quickly proving his organizational abilities and attention to detail. 

Now at Erebus Motorsport, Somchai is responsible for coordinating the complex movement of equipment and personnel to race events around the globe. He thrives under pressure, ensuring everything arrives on time and in perfect condition. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor and resourcefulness in solving logistical challenges. Somchai is known for his meticulous planning, a trait that minimizes delays and maximizes team efficiency. He’s always looking for innovative ways to streamline operations, contributing to Erebus Motorsport's competitive edge.

Somchai is dedicated to his role and is respected by his colleagues for his work ethic and positive attitude.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a lean build and a friendly smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and track tasks.
Has a habit of organizing his workspace before starting any new task.
Listens to traditional Thai folk music during breaks to unwind.
